title: Coral and the Static
author: Ulyana Whitlock
blurb: Jude Yarrow, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
